data.title: A potential Democrat administration won't hurt Bitcoin: VanEck
data.description: VanEck's Matthew Sigel says Democrat's victory in the midterm elections would not hurt Bitcoin, but could be a problem for other cryptocurrencies. He says President Trump’s support for Bitcoin, along with his family’s stake in World Liberty Financial is positive for the U.S. economy because digital assets have the potential to unleash productivity gains.
